entries.title: Chapter 00 | Prelude
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story begins! But first, a little pre-reamble...

entries.title: Chapter 01 | Cutsceen Chaos
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! We land on Delfino Airstrip to be greeted by chaos... and a lot of cutsceens!

entries.title: Chapter 02 | Delfino Destiny
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we obtain a whopping 10 shines in Delfino Plaza to skip ahead in the level order!

entries.title: Chapter 03 | Pinna Panic
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we tackle the first half of Pinna Park as well as the majority of its blue coins!

entries.title: Chapter 04 | Pinna Perfect
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we complete Pinna Park 100% perfect!

entries.title: Chapter 05 | My Boy Ricco
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we start perhaps my favourite level, Ricco Harbor!

entries.title: Chapter 06 | Harbor Maintenance
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we wrap things up in Ricco Harbor!

entries.title: Chapter 07 | Delfino Re-Destiny
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we collect the remaining shines and blue coins in Delfino Plaza!

entries.title: Chapter 08 | A Fiery Welcome
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we begin Pianta Village, which is on fire...

entries.title: Chapter 09 | Stranger Danger
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we begin complete the village underside; but be careful talking to strangers...

entries.title: Chapter 10 | Pianta Picnic
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we finish Pianta Village with a lovely fluff festival!

entries.title: Chapter 11 | Beginners' Bad Luck
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we start Bianco Hills, which I forgot existed...

entries.title: Chapter 12 | Failing and Flailing
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we continue Bianco Hills, which isn't going so well...

entries.title: Chapter 13 | No Steam Ahead
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we finish Bianco Hills, hopefully before I fall asleep...

entries.title: Chapter 14 | Skipping Dessert
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we start Gelato Beach with the one and only Gelato skip!

entries.title: Chapter 15 | Finishing with Dessert
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we knock out the rest of Gelato Beach (which we skipped last time!)

entries.title: Chapter 16 | Oki Doki Noki Bay
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we start Noki Bay and knock out a ton of shines!

entries.title: Chapter 17 | Stories and Coin Hunting
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we have a relaxing time telling stories and hunting blue coins in Noki Bay!

entries.title: Chapter 18 | Swimming in the Deep
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we complete Noki Bay and end off back in the Noki Depths!

entries.title: Chapter 19 | Manta's 100 Coins
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we start Sirena Beach with the Manta Storm and a difficult 100 coin hunt!

entries.title: Chapter 20 | Hotel Hijinks
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we continue Sirena Beach and take on the very mysterious hotel!

entries.title: Chapter 21 | Sayonora Sirena
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we finish Sirena Beach, our last full level of the game!

entries.title: Chapter 22 | Flooding the Ocean
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story continues! Today we take care of that pesky flooded ocean!

entries.title: Chapter 23 | Hot Tub Showdown
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story concludes! Today we take on the final boss of the game!

entries.title: Chapter 24 | Epilogue
entries.description: Our Super Mario Sunshine story has concluded! Let's roll the credits and keep a promise made long ago!
